question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin grow built-in hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval now, and if so should hybrid be default-on or opt-in?
rationale: The request is valid but changes an official plugin's retrieval ranking, config surface, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback policy; those choices should be intentional before automation writes a fix.

options.title: Approve opt-in hybrid
options.body: Add hybrid search behind explicit plugin config first, preserving vector-only default behavior while validating LanceDB API support and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve default-on hybrid
options.body: Make hybrid retrieval the default for new and existing `memory-lancedb` users, accepting the ranking and index-lifecycle change as desired product behavior.

options.title: Defer LanceDB parity
options.body: Keep `memory-lancedb` vector-only for now and direct users who need hybrid ranking to memory-core or an external ClawHub plugin until ownership is clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in hybrid
recommendation.body: Add hybrid search behind explicit plugin config first, preserving vector-only default behavior while validating LanceDB API support and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Most current-source and recent-area evidence points to steipete for `memory-lancedb` behavior review and the prior maintainer-side issue assessment.
